- BlackRock (BLK) shares are responding to this morning's earnings. item.title: Resilient Growth Cushions Tech Amid Rising Rates
item.description: [Bloomberg] Julia Hermann of New York Life Management tells Vonnie that the current macro and market backdrop remains favorable: economic growth is resilient, and although rates are rising, they have not yet climbed enough to threaten the growth outlook. Addressing concern that remarks from Broadcom and Intel CEOs could signal a tech selloff, she says investor focus has shifted. After years of watching for a lower limit on company investment, markets are increasingly concerned that spending—first among hyperscalers and now in chips—could become so high that it threatens free cash flow.
